name: Guillain-Barre Syndrome

category.name: Neurologic
category.part: AME Physical Examination Information and Disposition Tables

what_to_bring: A current, detailed neurological evaluation, in accordance with the FAA Specifications for Neurologic Evaluation, generated from a clinic visit with the treating neurologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam.
It must specifically include if there is any persisting deficit and period of stability without symptoms.
Other testing already performed or deemed necessary by the pilot's physician.

rows.evaluation_data: Submit the following for FAA review: 1. A current, detailed neurological evaluation, in accordance with the FAA Specifications for Neurologic Evaluation, generated from a clinic visit with the treating neurologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam. 2. It must specifically include if there is any persisting deficit and period of stability without symptoms. 3. Other testing already performed or deemed necessary by the pilot's physician. rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit the following for FAA review:

1. A current, detailed neurological evaluation, in accordance with the FAA Specifications for Neurologic Evaluation, generated from a clinic visit with the treating neurologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam.

2. It must specifically include if there is any persisting deficit and period of stability without symptoms.

3. Other testing already performed or deemed necessary by the pilot's physician.

Note: If associated with a seizure, refer to the Seizure section. A recovery period may apply.
